step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture shows SoftChef's MIAP (IoT platform) running inside a Customer AWS Account container. Ground devices connected through a Greengrass gateway stream telemetry up to IoT Core, which writes device data to DynamoDB. Web and Mobile clients authenticate via Cognito, send requests to API Gateway, which invokes a Lambda function to query telemetry from DynamoDB. Additionally, clients establish a direct MQTT connection to IoT Core for real-time telemetry streaming and device shadow control. CloudFormation and AWS SAR are omitted as they serve deployment purposes rather than acting as active runtime message/data routing nodes.

nodes.name: IOT CORE

nodes.name: GREENGRASS

edges.notes: Greengrass gateway collects local device data and sends it up to IoT Core.
IoT Core routes and saves telemetry data directly into DynamoDB.
Web/Mobile Client authenticates user identity via Cognito.
Web/Mobile Client calls API Gateway endpoints after authentication.
Lambda fetches stored telemetry data from DynamoDB to display on client UI.
Web/Mobile Client establishes MQTT connection with IoT Core for real-time visualization and shadow control.
